 Another Banner Day For The Jets: Aaron Glenn Got Caught On A Mic Saying That It'd Be A Flag 'If It Was Josh Allen' After Geno Got Hit
 Reags 11/15/2026 11:12 PM Facebook Icon 9 This is Jets football at its finest. Blame the refs, blame everyone else, never take into account that you're just a garbage franchise. I would never blame a ref. I would never say my guy doesn't get the call because he's one of the faces of the league and married to a rocket ship. No, when you're Aaron Glenn you do whatever it takes to come close to a win. You at least gotta try to make a point. 
 This was the call in question 
 Let me be clear. Football is a physical sport. The less flags the better. Let guys hit each other. You should be able to tackle someone and not have 100,000 people look around for a flag. I hate that part of the game with every part of my body. You get a 3rd down stop and you just assume there's a flag.
 Either way, I want to feel bad for Jets fans but fuck them. You at least got a bunch of draft picks but this team stinks. There's minimal hope for the Jets. So instead of taking accountability just yell that Josh Allen would get the call. Big brain play by Aaron Glenn because at least he didn't say anything dumb this time like the Jets on the cusp of being great at 2-7.
